observation.command:
sleep 60; echo "=== readiness now ==="; ok=0; bad=""; for p in 18000 18001 18002 18003 18005 18006 18007 18008 18009 18010 18011 18012 18013 18014 18015 18016 18020 18021 18022 18024 3002; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 3 http://localhost:$p/docs 2>/dev/null); if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then ok=$((ok+1)); else bad="$bad $p=$code"; fi; done; echo "OK: $ok/21 Not-200:$bad"; echo "=== mem ==="; free -h | head -2
echo "=== restart count per dead service ==="; for s in project-logic document-management formal-completeness; do echo "$s: started-reloader=$(grep -c "$s.*Started reloader" /tmp/process-compose.log) finished=$(grep -c "$s.*Finished server process" /tmp/process-compose.log)"; done
